title: Search Model and Query Reference
readerIntent: Locate provider-neutral search ownership, operations, extension points, and verification.
priorKnowledge: Understand Nodics modules, schemas, routes, services, and pipelines.
summary: The search module owns provider-neutral models, APIs, pipelines, cache policy, fallback semantics, and normalized errors.

sections.heading: Purpose and authority
items: A search model describes provider-neutral query and index behavior aligned with an owning business schema. It never replaces the authoritative item model or database service.
Define searchable, filterable, sortable, facetable, projected, localized, and masked fields explicitly with tenant and catalog context.
Display identity uses safe business code and description; opaque identifiers remain references and protected fields never enter an index accidentally.

sections.heading: Index definition and lifecycle
items: The owning module declares index name, version, source projection, mappings, analyzers, aliases, refresh policy, and compatibility while nSearch executes provider operations.
Build a candidate index, populate from authorized source services, validate counts and samples, then activate an alias atomically where supported.
Schema changes classify compatible mapping updates versus rebuilds and retain rollback until the new projection is verified.

sections.heading: Query contract
items: Normalize text, filters, ranges, sort, page, size, cursor, projection, locale, and context; reject unbounded, unsupported, or provider-specific query injection.
Apply authorization and field masking before results leave the service. Search permission does not imply create, update, delete, or unrestricted read.
Deterministic pagination requires stable ordering and documented maximums; scores and highlights are derived explanations rather than business truth.

sections.heading: Verification and recovery
items: Test indexing, update, delete, rebuild, alias switch, empty query, typo/analyzer behavior, filters, sort, pagination, locale, masking, tenant isolation, and scale.
Test provider outage, partial batch, mapping conflict, stale projection, duplicate events, import completion, cache interaction, restart, recovery, and regression.
Measure query latency, error, zero-result rate, indexing throughput, lag, failed documents, alias state, and rebuild progress with safe bounded labels.

sections.heading: Authoritative source locations
items: Business index declarations: owning module src/search/indexes.js.
Engine adapters: sibling provider modules under gFramework/nSearch or later project modules.
Configuration: layered properties.js and approved secret/runtime governance.

sections.heading: Focused verification
paragraphs: Retain representative authorized queries and expected projections as compatibility evidence whenever schema, analyzer, mapping, provider, or pagination behavior changes.
